title: Pauta audit report
description: One app audited against one edition of Pauta: a result for every rule in scope. Written as docs/pauta-audit.json beside docs/pauta-audit.md.

commit.description: The commit audited, as a short or full SHA.

appEdition.description: The edition the app names (pauta.version), when it is not `edition`: one with no rules.json, or none at all (null).

scope.description: What was audited: empty for every rule, else the prefixes, page slugs or rule IDs given.

rules.description: Where the rules came from: the edition's rules.json URL or a local path.

results.description: One result per rule in scope, in the edition's rule order.

evidence.description: Where the verdict comes from, as path/File.java:123 from the repository root, and what is missing for a fail. For an exception, its pauta.json reason; for limited, the feature the app lacks; for manual, what to look at, in the running app or where the Check says, ending "not recorded" when pauta.json has no `checked` entry for the rule; for not-checked, what would settle it.

checked.description: For a manual result: the app's pauta.json `checked` entry for this rule (Conformance, PAUTA-18), when it has one. A result without it is not recorded, which is not a finding and not a problem.

edition.description: The edition the rule was checked against.

version.description: The app's own version at the check, where the entry records it.

problem.description: What is wrong with the app's pauta.json about this rule: an entry for a rule that passes or is limited, a deviation on a MUST, a deviation or pending entry with no link, a level or url that differs from the edition's, a `checked` entry that is stale (its edition is older than the rule's `changed` in rules.json), or a `checked` entry for a rule that also has an exception. A rule with no `checked` entry is not one: an app records the entries it chooses to (PAUTA-18).

problems.description: Findings no rule of the edition holds: a pauta.json entry for a retired or unknown ID, an edition named differently in pom.xml and the README.
